cases.input: A coordinator launches more agents whenever work slows. Provider 429s, queue age, RAM, and duplicate retries all rise while throughput stops improving.
Two agents update the same repository file in parallel and each write depends on the blob SHA returned by the previous write.
The SDK already retries 429s, the worker retries the SDK call, and the orchestrator retries the worker with no shared retry budget.
After context compaction, the summary keeps progress notes but drops a hard requirement that the repair must preserve two independent accounts.
A checkpoint records a process ID, branch head, and MCP session ID. The task resumes the next day after the app and bridge restarted.
A new agent session sees substantial progress and declares the multi-stage task finished without checking the acceptance ledger.
A plugin passes repository CI but the target ChatGPT surface has not imported, synced, loaded, or behaviorally exercised that revision.
A CLI launched through a moving latest tag behaves differently from the version tested in the repository lockfile.
A connector accepts a syntactically valid create request and returns success, but the target object cannot be read back.
A search/list tool returns 20 items and no one checks whether the response is paginated or truncated before concluding only 20 objects exist.
An effectful tool times out after the server may already have committed the action. The client considers retrying immediately.
A cheaper model is faster but fails an acceptance-critical verification task twice as often on the protected eval set.
A workflow contains low-risk classification, deep architecture analysis, and an irreversible deployment decision.
A request changes processing service tier to reduce cost or latency, and the operator concludes the model's reasoning capability itself changed.
A complex incident mentions MCP, Windows, two accounts, GitHub, and cost. The router loads every available skill into context before identifying the primary failure.
